Karnataka HC orders BDA to provide 18-metre access road

The Karnataka High Court has directed the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) to provide an 18-metre access road to properties in Jakkur. The court reprimanded the BDA chief for reducing the road width. The order mandates the BDA to ensure the access road is provided to the Jakkur plantation properties.
